summary: R89 sexies verified: (a) backend email endpoint sends PDF attachment (mock captures attachments list with mime_type=application/pdf and content starting with %PDF-), (b) frontend PreventivoStampa page renders iframe pointing to backend PDF endpoint (same source as download/attachment). Backend 7/7 pytest pass. Frontend E2E confirmed iframe src -> /api/preventivi/{id}/pdf?token=..., PDF fetched with HTTP 200 and %PDF- magic bytes, email dialog opens and closes on successful send (POST /api/preventivi/{id}/invia-email returns ok=true).
critical_code_review_comments: PreventivoStampa.jsx is ~960 lines; still holds legacy hidden HTML rendering. Consider removing entirely once no legacy consumer exists (currently kept as fallback for #print-area references) to reduce bundle size.
Email deliverability (SPAM/SPF/DKIM on sadicasa.it) is out of scope — codice invia PDF correttamente; user should verify DNS records on the production domain.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test preventivo bagno-gold during E2E test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: R89 sexies unifies preview via backend weasyprint PDF (iframe). Backend send-email now attaches PDF (attachments list with mime_type=application/pdf). Frontend uses POST /api/preventivi/{id}/invia-email (legacy alias, also /send-email exists). Both aliases confirmed working.
rca of the issue: N/A — fix verified working end-to-end. User-reported divergence between preview and download is resolved by rendering the same backend PDF in iframe. Email attachment (missing PDF) is fixed by the new attachments parameter in email_service.send_email + auto pdf generation inside send_preventivo_email.
